messages:
aria: Quick question — for per-route saved queries in Console, should we surface route-level routing / quota hints (pinned model, sample rate, fallback) directly on the saved-query card, or keep them inside the expanded filter/details panel? Need opinions before I spin up a design spike. @mike @jen

mike: Card-level summary wins for discoverability. Most users glance at the list, they won't expand every item. Show 2-3 compact badges (pinned-model, sample-rate, quota-tier). Clicking a badge opens the details panel.

jen: Agree on badges but only when they differ from route defaults — otherwise it's noise. Also calls out an API change: savedQuery payload needs routeMetadata { pinnedModel, sampleRate, quotaHint }. That impacts savedquery service and migrations.

aria: Do we make those fields optional on the schema? Current savedquery is minimal. Backfill strategy?

mike: Make optional. Backend can infer from route config for existing saved queries and populate lazily on read/write. No mass-migration if we default to null.

sam: Rollout thought — feature-flag badges, start internal-only then a % ramp. Telemetry we should collect: badge_click, expand, apply_override. Need explicit event names.

jen: API debate: should this be savedQuery.scope vs savedQuery.routeMetadata? I prefer routeMetadata to avoid conflating with our routing engine semantics. Keeps intent clearer for frontend.

mike: UX detail — when quota differs between route and pinned model, show a small :warning: pill "quota mismatch" with hover tooltip explaining the delta and suggested fallback.

aria: Mock plan: small badge row on the left, then description, then actions. Prototype in Figma tomorrow. Telemetry snippet for the analytics team: 

```json
{
  "event": "savedquery.badge_click",
  "props": { "badge": "pinned_model", "route_id": "r-123", "savedquery_id": "sq-456" }
}
```

jen: We'll wire the events into the console analytics pipeline. Important: sampling decisions must respect the route's sample rate so we don't overcount for high-traffic routes.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary deployed console-badges-v2 to staging at 2024-05-02T17:31:00Z :rocket:

mike: Copy/labeling decision — keep badges really short: e.g. "Pinned: gpt-open-7b" or just "gpt-open-7b" with hover text for full name. Short is better in tight lists.

aria: Also thinking keyboard accessibility: small key (e.g. Enter or Space) to expand details when focused on a saved query card. Add that to the prototype.

sam: Can we include a lightweight indicator for routing policy (e.g., "fallbacks enabled")? Might help debugging when a saved query references a model that's only available on certain tiers.

aria: Filed a tiny ticket CONSOLE-1428 with mocks, API contract sketch, and rollout plan. I'll ping when the figma link is up. Thanks all :thumbsup:
